parameters.name: DatasetName
parameters.description: The dataset name. For information about how to obtain the dataset name, see [CreateDataset](~~478160~~).

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
- The maximum number of bindings to return. Valid values: 0 to 200.
- If this parameter is not set or is set to 0, the default value 100 is used.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the binding task.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
- The pagination token that is used when the total number of bindings exceeds the MaxResults value.
- Binding information is returned in alphabetical order starting from the NextToken value.
- Leave this parameter empty for the first request.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see [CreateProject](~~478153~~).
